key_insight: Transformers trained on synthetic limit order book streams learn predictive behavior consistent with Bayesian inference over market regimes, with generalization driven more by regime diversity than scale.
engineering_relevance: For financial simulation and model calibration—not materials discovery—frozen model representations enable accurate, lower-cost estimation of simulator parameters.
method: Train GPT-style models on synthetic order flow with known latent market parameters.
Compare predictions with exact Bayes-optimal predictors and oracle entropy floors, including drifting regimes.
Decode latent regimes from frozen activations and test transfer to real NASDAQ order flow.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports predictions within a millinat per token of the exact Bayes optimum, better calibration than windowed maximum likelihood, and pretraining gains at every tested budget across held-out tickers.
watch_item: Zero-shot transfer depends on how well the simulator prior covers real order flow; synthetic accuracy alone does not establish real-market robustness.
paper_title: What Do Foundation Models for Market Microstructure Learn? A Controlled Study with Synthetic Limit Order Books
